mapper.update: UPDATE notify_reminders SET status = 'canceled' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('pending', 'processing')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_reminders (id, user_id, task_id, reminder_key, occurrence_key, remind_at, status, attempt_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{reminderKey}, #{occurrenceKey}, #{remindAt}, 'pending', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(notify_reminders.status = 'sent', 'sent', 'pending'), claimed_at = IF(notify_reminders.status = 'sent', notify_reminders.claimed_at, NULL), sent_at = IF(notify_reminders.status = 'sent', notify_reminders.sent_at, NULL), attempt_count = IF(notify_reminders.status = 'sent', notify_reminders.attempt_count, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notify_reminders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('pending', 'processing')
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_reminders SET status = #{status}, sent_at = #{sentAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notify_reminders SET status = 'expired' WHERE status = 'pending' AND remind_at < #{cutoff}
UPDATE notify_reminders SET status = 'pending', claimed_at = NULL WHERE status = 'processing' AND claimed_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notify_reminders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notify_reminders WHERE status IN ('sent', 'failed', 'canceled', 'expired') AND created_at < #{cutoff}
